summary: Agent skill for Claude Code and Codex that builds single-file HTML slide decks in magazine or Swiss styles, with a full presenter mode.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Guizang PPT Skill is a skill for Claude Code, Codex and similar agents. It generates swipeable single-file HTML slide decks, slide visuals and social media covers. It has two visual systems: an editorial magazine style for talks with a personal voice, and a grid-based Swiss style for facts, products and analysis.
sixtySeconds.problem: Making a polished talk deck takes design time. This skill gets your agent to build one from your content, and adds speaker notes, timing and a presenter view.
whoFor: Founders preparing demo days and launches
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for strong visual styles, a deck that's one HTML file with no build or server, and a built-in presenter mode with notes and rehearsal timing.
requirements: Claude Code, Codex or another agent with file and shell access

overview: Install with the skills CLI or by cloning into ~/.claude/skills. Then ask your agent for something like a magazine-style deck or a Swiss-style deck and the skill is used automatically.
Style A has 10 layouts and 5 themes; Style B has 22 locked layouts and 4 themes, and a brand color can become a matching theme. In Codex it can also generate images for slides.
Press P in a deck to open presenter mode with current and next slides, notes and timing. It suits talks and launches, not data-heavy tables or training decks. It is AGPL-3.0 licensed.
limitations: Not for data-heavy or training decks
